provenance.method: Disassembly of the full-device dictionary helper used by passcode and QR generate, its Computer Name, model and OS-version helpers, and every caller. The official client has not run these inputs; DR-OBS-031 corroborates only the computer-name-present case

notes: Inputs are what the macOS sources return: computer_name is SCDynamicStoreCopyComputerName (null = unavailable), hw_model is sysctlbyname("hw.model") (null = size 0 or unavailable), os_version is NSProcessInfo.operatingSystemVersion. Expected output is the full device object minus uuid. All values are synthetic.

cases.name: computer name is sent unchanged, with no host-name rewriting
dots and a .local-looking suffix are not stripped
long non-ASCII name is neither truncated nor trimmed

input.computer_name: 회의실 맥미니 — 3층 서쪽 끝 공용 장비 (대여 문의는 총무팀으로)

device.name: 회의실 맥미니 — 3층 서쪽 끝 공용 장비 (대여 문의는 총무팀으로)

cases.name: an empty computer name is returned as-is, without falling back
unavailable computer name falls back to the hardware model identifier
every name source unavailable sends an empty name and an empty model
